questions: Is sewage connected to every plot?
answer: Underground sewage pipelines run at the centre of the roads and connect to every plot. An advanced Sewage Treatment Plant purifies the wastewater and reuses it for the greenery, keeping the township clean, odour-free and mosquito-free.
facts: Underground sewage pipelines at the centre of roads

answer: Modern storm water drains run along both sides of the roads with recharge pits at frequent intervals. That prevents waterlogging and also helps raise the groundwater level.
